breakdown.description: The prompt treats equal axial force as if it implied equal normal stress in both stepped segments; the force is the same in series, but the stress depends on each segment’s area.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes different normal stresses for each segment (σ₁ ≈ 61.1 MPa, σ₂ ≈ 31.2 MPa) based on their respective cross-sectional areas, rather than treating them as equal. This fixes the error of assuming equal stress in both segments.

breakdown.description: The prompt enforces a common elongation for the two stepped segments, which is a compatibility condition for parallel members, not for segments connected in series.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the segments as series members by computing individual elongations (δ₁ and δ₂) and summing them to get the total elongation, rather than enforcing a common elongation (parallel compatibility condition). This correctly applies the series deformation approach.
